release_notes:
UPDATE v1.1.5

TELEGRAM BOT & REMOTE CONTROL:
1. Fixed "Token not recognized" — the tool now reliably registers its token with the central server
   - Added OS certificate-store trust (truststore) so TLS-scanning antivirus (Avast/ESET/Kaspersky) no longer breaks the HTTPS connection to the server
   - Outbound requests now bypass the tunnel reminder page so status reports and commands get through
   - Corrected the central server URL used by the tool
2. Remote commands (assign accounts / start / clear) now apply within seconds via a fast command poll instead of waiting minutes
3. Assigned accounts are now auto-checked in the Automation table (fixed the checkbox-delegate mismatch)
4. Automation completion alert now reaches the bot/panel reliably (uses the correct device token)
5. Consistent notifications for clear actions; removed a completion-dialog notification loop

STATUS REPORTING:
6. Account status summary is now complete — every status is categorized so counts reconcile to the total (e.g. "Completed" now counts as Working)
7. Bot /working, /failed, /checkpoint now group all related statuses

ALL PREVIOUS FIXES INCLUDED:
- Schedule Tab 500+ account reliability (v1.1.4)
- Auto-resume crash fix (v1.1.4)
- Schedule Tab UI & Worker improvements (v1.1.3)
- Immediate Stop Crash Fix (v1.1.2)
- Browser Count Decrement + User Config Respect (v1.1.1)
- 200+ Accounts Crash Fix, Batch Cleanup, Auto-Start, Resource Timeout (v1.1.0)

STABILITY:
- All previous stability improvements maintained
